title: Storage Lectern
description: You can <positive>combine</positive> multiple <keyword>chests</keyword> or any other <keyword>storage containers</keyword> into a single, very user-friendly <keyword>crafting interface</keyword> - it's literally <named>AE2</named> on a minimal setup.
With a Dominion Wand in hand, shift + right click a storage container to designate it, and then right click the storage lectern to bind the two.
Will not function without a bookwyrm, but can have more than one. Each bookwyrm allows connecting 8 more containers.
